title: Pretty curtains, but arrived with a defect.
text: Pretty curtains, but arrived with a defect.. Very pretty curtains. Look gorgeous although they are a thinner material. We wanted some light while also enjoying privacy. These were perfect. My only complaint is that one of the panels arrived with a snag in the design, which is highly visible with the light coming through it. And it is located in an obvious area. I am disappointed in that. If returns or exchanges were free, I would have requested a replacement.
